flawless: The Hurloon horn has sounded, and you did not land a single blow.
My grandsire wrestled bears for sport. You were lighter work.
solid: Good! You strike like a minotaur calf. Grow your horns, little one, and you'll be dangerous.
You bruised my hide. The Hurloon respect a bruise.
close: Horns and hooves, that was close! The elders will snort at me for weeks.
I am still standing, though only just. You fight like a whole herd.
